script: No spread or total was saved for Week 5 LV at NE, so this script is form-only. Over weeks 2-4 LV funneled 55 carries to Ashton Jeanty (162 yards, 2.95 YPC) and 17 to Mike Washington (79 yards, 4.65 YPC) while Kirk Cousins supported Brock Bowers (24 targets, 202 yards, 254 air yards), Tre Tucker (19 targets, 206 yards, 307 air yards) and Michael Mayer (17 targets, 137 yards). NE split TreVeyon Henderson (38/141) and Rhamondre Stevenson (26/112) and got 12 Drake Maye rushes for 94 yards, with Romeo Doubs at 17 targets for 203 yards. NE blitzes 37% and Cousins' EPA/dropback is 0.20 vs blitz (n=41) against 0.15 without, so LV should stay pass-willing; LV allows 5.23 YPC and 13 runs of 10+, so NE can lean on Henderson, Stevenson and Maye on the ground.
who_goes_off: Michael Mayer and Brock Bowers are the LV pass pieces who fit the hole: Mayer 137 yards on 17 targets and Bowers 202 on 24, against a NE middle that allows 12.5 YPA. Ashton Jeanty should still pile touches (55 carries plus 19 targets, 120 receiving yards, only 25 air yards). For NE, Romeo Doubs (203 yards, 247 air yards on 17 targets) is the receiver most likely to separate, and Henderson (141 rush yards) plus Stevenson (112 rush, 46 receiving) can both eat into a LV run defense at 5.23 YPC.
weak_spot: NE's location split is the tell: middle 12.5 YPA on 24 attempts versus left 5.65 on 52 and right 4.65 on 49, so the matchup is the middle — linebackers, nickel and safeties — not the outside corners, and NE has allowed only 10 passes of 20+ on 134 attempts. LV's clearer leak is the run, 5.23 YPC and 13 gains of 10+, with a milder middle leak at 9.0 YPA on 20 attempts versus 7.73 left (52) and 5.74 right (54), plus 10 explosives on 139 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for LV or NE, so no injury fallout is priced. Week 2-4 usage is the role map: Jeanty 55 carries and 19 targets, Washington 17 carries, Bowers 24 targets, Mayer 17, Tucker 19, Henderson 38 carries, Stevenson 26 carries and 11 targets, Doubs 17 targets, Hunter Henry 12 targets for 107 yards.
qb_vs_blitz: Kirk Cousins is better into pressure, 0.20 EPA/dropback vs blitz on 41 dropbacks against 0.15 with no blitz, and New England blitzes 37%, so LV's air-yard pieces (Tucker 307, Bowers 254) are not blitzed off the field. Drake Maye is worse vs blitz, -0.06 EPA on 45 dropbacks against 0.06 with no blitz, but Las Vegas blitzes only 25%, so Maye should mostly get the no-blitz look where his EPA is positive.

picks.why: Michael Mayer averaged 45.7 receiving yards on 17 targets and 88 air yards over weeks 2-4 against a 29-yard line, and New England allows 12.5 YPA on 24 middle attempts versus 5.65 left and 4.65 right, so his intermediate TE usage hits the only soft zone on that defense.

Ashton Jeanty combined 162 rush yards on 55 carries with 120 receiving yards on 19 targets over weeks 2-4, 94 per game versus a 75.5 rush+rec line, and NE allows 4.44 YPC, above his 2.95, while the 120 yards came on only 25 air yards so the receiving floor does not need explosives.
